responsibility: Target-query shim for machine properties needed by the BRIG frontend. It currently supplies placeholder implementations for mapping BRIG segments to target address-space IDs and for reporting the target wave size, providing the abstraction point where backend-specific or multi-address-space behavior could later be inserted.
same_name_distinction: Contains the current stub implementations of the machine-query layer declared in brig-machine.h, returning placeholder target address-space IDs and wave size rather than just exposing the abstraction interface.
